did_not_reproduce: Absolute GAE and S on the two random-binary instances, whose native work is priced by ratios measured on the host in each run (calibration_pins.measured). Replay vs committed mean S: random 15 inherited-f4 261.96 vs 326.04, fes-then-batched 223.29 vs 277.51, pair table 473.68 vs 473.73; random 21 inherited-f4 2,973.19 vs 4,411.63, fes-then-batched 2,511.41 vs 3,726.09, pair table 1,975.74 vs 1,975.85. Cause: measured word-XOR ratio 0.003776 vs 0.004739 (random 15) and 0.003310 vs 0.004914 (random 21) GAE per XOR. In both runs the GAE rebuilds from the run's own counts at the run's own ratios to <= 3e-16 (committed) and 0 (replay). The ratio fes-then-batched / inherited-f4 moved from 0.8512 to 0.8524 (random 15) and 0.8446 to 0.8447 (random 21). These README numbers therefore recompute from the committed data but are not reproducible quantities; the count-based band is.
Wall-clock leaves (not part of S), the markdown rendering and the binary hash, as expected.
limitations: Same code lineage and same host class: the replay re-executes the repository's ic at a later commit; it is not an independent implementation and not a cross-host replay.

No IC report or rho record carries the base point or the target, so the discrete-log solves are checked as known-answer equalities (recovered = planted for each repeat, both written by the same process) and not by an independent [k]P = Q computation.
3 repeats per configuration (16 rho runs); the means carry wide per-repeat spread (e.g. inherited-f4 at Koblitz 17: 102.5 to 415.3), and no confidence interval was computed by the producer or here.

The pricing rule (price_phase's ten native counters, 1 GAE per group addition or doubling, solver ops at ns_per_op/ns_per_add) and the band's U (table_insert_attempts behind its marker) are transcribed from source; the recompute is independent code, not independent of those definitions. The rebuild of every phase gae from counts confirms the transcription on every row.
The band's rho side is a lower bound at w > 0: the rho records emit no unpriced counter (F8); a per-step sensitivity is reported, not gate evidence.

The validator holds no keyring key: pcc/keyring.json lists no keys, so `independent: true` here is a producer-style boolean under docs/SABOTAGE_RESISTANCE.md; pcc would grade the replay and recompute proofs not_covered until a keyring key signs them.
